Name: Skull Cavern Magic Door
Author: Jolamods
Description:
[b]Skip the desert trip.[/b] Craft a reusable door with the original Skull Cavern design, place it indoors or outdoors, and step straight into the entrance lobby. It uses the mini-obelisk's teleport effects and sound. No fuel, charges or second door needed.


[b]Mod has 2 versions:[/b]

[b]Standard:[/b] Mining lvl10, Skull Key and the Wizard's magical construction book unlocked. Costs 20 Iridium Bars, 1 Prismatic Shard, 100 Hardwood, 50 Solar Essence, 50 Void Essence and 10 Battery Packs.

[b]Easy:[/b] Mining lvl 3 and Skull Key. Costs 5 Iron Bars, 50 Wood, 25 Stone and 5 Solar Essence.

Both versions work the same. [b]Install only one.[/b]

[b]Installation[/b]
Requires Stardew Valley 1.6.14+ and SMAPI 4.5.2+. Extract Standard or Easy into your Mods folder. To switch versions, overwrite the same folder, including config.json.

[b]Translations[/b]
English is included. Optional text packs: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53336]Spanish[/url] · [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53337]Russian[/url] · [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53338]Simplified Chinese[/url] · [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53339]English[/url]. All work with Standard and Easy. Extract into Mods and merge the existing folder.

Travel is one way to the entrance lobby. You can pick up and move the door. Normal placement rules apply. In co-op, everyone should install the mod.Remove placed doors before uninstalling.

Original artwork and sounds are loaded from your game. The cover is an AI-generated promotional illustration; the gallery includes a real in-game screenshot.
